name: Generate a Spaced Repetition Quiz Schedule
prompt:
You are managing a vocabulary learning schedule. Given the following three words with their learned dates, compute their full spaced repetition review schedule and save the result to review_schedule.json.

Words and learned dates:
- "ephemeral" — learned on 2026-04-01
- "cacophony" — learned on 2026-04-05
- "sycophant" — learned on 2026-04-08

Spaced repetition intervals after learning: +1 day, +3 days, +7 days (1 week), +14 days (2 weeks), +30 days (1 month), +90 days (3 months).

For each word, calculate the exact calendar dates for all 6 review milestones. Save to review_schedule.json with this structure:
{
  "words": [
    {
      "word": "<string>",
      "learned": "<YYYY-MM-DD>",
      "reviews": [
        {"interval": "1d", "due": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"},
        {"interval": "3d", "due": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"},
        {"interval": "7d", "due": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"},
        {"interval": "14d", "due": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"},
        {"interval": "30d", "due": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"},
        {"interval": "90d", "due": "<YYYY-MM-DD>"}
      ],
      "mastery_date": "<YYYY-MM-DD — date of 90d review>"
    }
  ],
  "next_due": "<YYYY-MM-DD — earliest review date on or after 2026-04-11>",
  "next_word": "<string — word whose next review is on next_due>"
}

Calculate all dates precisely. For reference: April has 30 days. next_due should be the earliest review date across all words that falls on or after 2026-04-11.

criteria.description: review_schedule.json exists in the working directory.
review_schedule.json words array has 3 entries with next_due and next_word top-level fields present.
criteria.testPattern: has words array, next_due, next_word fields|contains 3 word entries

criteria.description: Each word entry has exactly 6 review objects covering all spaced repetition intervals.
Review interval labels are exactly "1d", "3d", "7d", "14d", "30d", "90d" for every word.
Each word's mastery_date equals the due date of its 90d review milestone.
next_due is "2026-04-11" and next_word is "sycophant" (earliest review on or after 2026-04-11).

eval.rubric:
Context: The agent computed a spaced repetition review schedule for three vocabulary words.

Criterion 1: Date Calculation Accuracy (Weight: 70%)
1.0: All review dates are arithmetically correct for all three words across all 6 intervals. next_due and next_word correctly identify the earliest upcoming review on or after 2026-04-11.
0.5: Most dates are correct but 1-2 entries have off-by-one errors.
0: Dates are systematically wrong or not calculated at all.

Criterion 2: Output Structure (Weight: 30%)
1.0: JSON is valid, all required fields present, interval labels match exactly (1d, 3d, 7d, 14d, 30d, 90d), mastery_date equals the 90d review date.
0.5: Structure mostly correct but some field names differ from spec.
0: Output is missing or not valid JSON.
eval.name: Quality Judge
